description: Corrected molecular-density source pilot and subsequent numerical refinements; not a full stellar-lifetime validation

records.name: rollback-control
records.purpose: Restore only the original density rollback; independent chemical check must reject it.

provenance.control: Restore only original INPC=0 molecular-density rollback; keep independent diagnostic.
Tighten only molecular equilibrium tolerance from .001 to 1e-8.

records.name: solar-he3-hot-convective-initialization
records.purpose: Native CONREF enabled only for the first three iterations to establish an initial convective profile; remaining eight iterations solve unchanged equilibrium equations. This completed target-composition model supplies only the initial guess for a separate canonical final-grid solve.

composition_interpolation.note: Current-source log interpolation of accepted surrounding nodes. Source density is diagnostic only; runtime uses the interior EOS at the actual composition. This is a local check, not a global interpolation-error bound.

material_grid_refinement.note: Temperature spacing is halved over the converged profile; density log10 spacing decreases from 0.5556 to 0.3944. The finer rectangle brackets the complete final profile. This is one local refinement test, not a global grid error bound.

convection_jacobian_control.note: Same original initial structure. Prior source needs Ng acceleration and 28 iterations; corrected source converges without acceleration in 8 iterations. Both final profiles pass the independent flux and chemistry checks.

opacity_derivative_control.note: Two native opacity derivative/state restoration repairs. Solar matching state remains within 6e-7 relative; this replay uses DERT=.001. At 3000 K/logg5.15, reducing DERT to 1e-5 removes the repeated small correction cycle and converges in three iterations with unchanged flux and correction criteria.
